say:1:1423338001:1.text: Okay, now everyone's been found. Game over! Time to go home!
say:1:1423338001:1.source_cn: 好啦，这下所有的人都被找到了，捉迷藏游戏顺利完成！大家...

say:3:1423338002:1.text: Go home? No way! We're not done playing!
say:3:1423338002:1.source_cn: 回家？不！我们还没玩够呢！

say:4:1423338003:1.text: Jamie brought grown-ups into the game. That's cheating! Jamie's a scaredy-cat!
say:4:1423338003:1.source_cn: 詹米找大人来当外援，詹米犯规！詹米是胆小鬼！

say:6:1423338004:1.text: I never said I'd go home if you found me—that was Jamie's promise, not mine! We're staying out here! We're gonna keep playing, and we're not stopping!
say:6:1423338004:1.source_cn: 我可没有答应被找到之后要回家，一定是詹米答应的！我们还...

say:8:1423338005:1.text: You nearly got attacked by that capshroom just now. You really want to keep hanging around out here?
say:8:1423338005:1.source_cn: 你刚刚都差点被幻灵孢菇攻击了，还要待在这里吗？

say:9:1423338006:1.text: That was just bad luck! Next time I'll hide somewhere safer...
say:9:1423338006:1.source_cn: 那只是个意外！大不了我下次藏在不那么偏僻的地方嘛……

say:10:1423338007:1.text: Look, it's fine to enjoy the game and have fun, but at your age, you can't be goofing off all the time...
say:10:1423338007:1.source_cn: 你们这么大的年纪，虽然可以尽情享受游戏的乐趣，但也不能...

say:11:1423338008:1.text: You've got to rest sometimes, too. Maybe read a book. Learn something new...
say:11:1423338008:1.source_cn: 也该抽时间安静下来，读一些书，学点东西……

say:13:1423338009:1.source_cn: 她说的是什么意思啊？我听不懂！

say:14:1423338010:1.text: Doesn't matter. We'll just end up as servants anyway. No point learning stuff that doesn't help with that...
say:14:1423338010:1.source_cn: 反正我们长大后最好的出路不过是去当贵族的仆从，学你说的...

say:15:1423338011:1.text: Servants? But the royal city isn't like that anymore...
say:15:1423338011:1.source_cn: 仆从？可是现在王城已经……

say:16:1423338012:1.text: Whatever. Jamie has a home to go back to. We don't. So leave us alone!
say:16:1423338012:1.source_cn: 总之，詹米是有家的孩子，詹米回家就好，我们更愿意待在这...
